info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Payroll Benefits Management API facilitates the update of various payroll and benefits parameters within the Human Resource Management system. This endpoint allows consumers to modify specific employee payroll benefits using identified parameters, improving the flexibility of HR operations. Common use cases include salary adjustments, benefits enhancements, or other related HR modifications that require precision and efficiency. This service is primarily used by HR professionals and system integrators to streamline payroll management processes.

patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the payroll benefits associated with a specific employee identified by their unique ID. It is essential for maintaining accurate records and ensuring that employees receive the correct benefits according to company policy.

requestBody.description: This PATCH request is used to update employee payroll benefits for the specified employee with ID EMP-900045. The request body should contain the fields that need to be updated in the employee's payroll benefits configuration.
